component.name: Linux iCloud Photos
component.summary: Unofficial iCloud Photos client that streams instead of syncing
Nieoficjalny klient iCloud Photos, który strumieniuje zamiast synchronizować

description.p: Browse your iCloud photos, albums, Live Photos and videos without syncing the library to disk. Only a small, size-limited thumbnail cache is kept.
Features: newest-first infinite scroll, zoom, photo information, slideshows, upload with album choice, and casting to DLNA/UPnP, Chromecast and AirPlay (Apple TV) receivers.
This is an unofficial application, not affiliated with Apple Inc. Advanced Data Protection must be turned off.
Picker mode for other apps (linux-whazzapp).
Automatic refresh when iCloud file links expire.
Credits shown under the version number.
Background helper that keeps the app icon in step with the system theme.
Fix for iCloud download links that contain a filename placeholder.
App icon follows the light/dark system theme.
Dark app icon.
Send to TV straight from the right-click menu in albums.
More reliable casting to LG webOS TVs and Chromecast.
Better DLNA compatibility when casting photos to TVs.
The Flatpak is no longer experimental.
Video playback in the Flatpak plays a cached local file.
No slideshow button on videos; clearer video error.
Version shown on the login screen.
Flatpak installs the video codec extension explicitly.
Flatpak build fix for the desktop entry.
Flatpak build only needs wheels for the build machine architecture.
Renamed to Linux iCloud Photos; Flatpak build uses ready-made wheels for packages with compiled code.
Refresh button, slideshow only inside albums, more readable transparency.
Fixed slow photo deletion, optional German and Ukrainian interface, window transparency, slideshow button changes.
English and Polish interface, chosen by the system language.
Add to album from the right-click menu and the viewer, with recent albums and a search box.
Adds a Google Photos-style rows layout.
Adding photos to an album skips photos that are already in it.
Rubber-band (drag) selection of photos.
Session-expiry handling, jump to a date, multi-select actions and a settings window.
Fixes video playback and adds an original-proportions grid option.
Adds AirPlay (Apple TV) casting and a Flatpak package; removes the experimental Memories feature.
